title: BBN and CMB constraints on the mediator required for the LZ inelastic cross-section: dark photons, dark Higgs and light Z' in the early Universe
question: Do the dark photon, dark Higgs and Z' mediators of the LZ inelastic fits survive BBN, CMB spectral distortions, Planck, N_eff and self-interaction constraints, and what part of the P011 (m_A', eps) band remains?
headline_result: The LZ-fit dark photon decays in <4e-8 s and thermalises for eps>~1e-8, so it is invisible to BBN/FIRAS/N_eff; the dark Higgs it requires, if m_hD <~ 0.7 m_A' without Higgs-portal mixing, is a late-decaying relic excluded for eps <~ 1e-5-1e-4, removing m_A' <~ 4-10 GeV at delta=300 keV; the Planck-allowed window 9.2-34.8 GeV survives.
key_numbers: tau_A' on band 3.9e-8 (0.3 GeV) to 2e-18 s (30 GeV); tau_A'=1 s at eps=2.2e-11/2.1e-12 (0.3/10 GeV); eps_therm=2.0e-9/6.4e-9/1.6e-8 (0.3/1/10 GeV); freeze-in A' excluded only m_A'<=0.23 GeV, eps<=2.5e-11; DeltaN_eff=0 (T_dec>0.11/0.17 GeV needed for relativistic scalar/vector); h_D relic/rho_DM = 1.8e3/2.4/1.9e-4/6e-7 at r=0.5/0.7/0.9/1.2 (1 GeV); tau_h(r=0.9,eps=1e-6)=3.5e6 s; h_D excluded eps<=1.8e-4 (r=0.5), 1.8e-5 (0.7); portal theta>=1e-8; sigma_T/m<=5.5e-4 cm2/g; surviving delta=300: m_A'=9.2-34.8 GeV, eps=7e-5-1e-3
model_or_mechanism: pseudo-Dirac DM with kinetically mixed dark photon + dark Higgs; thermal history (g* from exact integrals), inverse-decay thermalisation, freeze-in, forbidden-channel Boltzmann relic, A'-loop and 4f dark-Higgs decays, KKM/FIRAS/Slatyer-Wu criteria, classical Yukawa SIDM
agent_tools: Read x13, Bash x12, Write x4, Edit x18
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13, numpy 2.5.3, scipy 1.18.1 (quad, solve_ivp Radau, kve, brentq), pandas 3.0.5, matplotlib 3.11.2, common/lzcommon.py
